readerCopy.body: A bigger opportunity can arrive with an unspoken request to become easier for a larger system to approve of. When Jupiter opposes Lilith, expansion and autonomy face each other directly, putting money, access, education, travel, visibility, or influence across from a desire or boundary the opportunity would prefer to keep quiet. You may notice that the offer becomes more complicated once the part expected to stay outside the agreement is named. The benefits can still be substantial, but the price deserves to be visible too.
